endpoints.payer: Bucket owner. Every request was unsigned, so no requester was charged. A requester-pays bucket refuses unsigned requests.

limitations: Headers, listings, and settings text only. No pixel was decoded, so masking, value ranges, and negative values are untested. Probe T4 reads pixels.
GDAL requests and bytes come from its debug log of requested ranges, the first bytes of each file. They include no decoded block.
Three tile-dates. The layer set, encoding, and settings of other scenes can differ.
Grid alignment compares the Level-2A 20 m grid from catalog metadata, not from the Level-2A file headers.
Object last-modified times describe the bucket copy, not when USGS processed a scene.
The payer statement rests on unsigned requests succeeding. No price page was read.
